title: Norm bound for Boolean noise averaging
statement:
Let $N$ be a natural number, let $0\leq\rho\leq1$, and let $F:\{0,1\}^N\times\{0,1\}^N\to\mathbb C$ satisfy $\|F(x,y)\|\leq C$ for every $x,y$. Then the norm of the sum of $F(x,y)$ weighted by the noise kernel and the uniform weight obeys
\[
\left\|2^{-N}\sum_{x,y\in\{0,1\}^N}K_\rho(x,y)F(x,y)\right\|\leq C.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a complex-valued function on pairs of Boolean-cube points
